title: Run the auto-mode safety classifier on a cheaper model
description: Auto mode classifies every tool call for safety using the same model as the conversation, so an Opus session pays Opus rates for a classification task Haiku handles well. Set CLAUDE_CLASSIFIER_MODEL to override it, e.g. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Unset, nothing changes.

sites.description: Whatever identifier is handed to the classifier request as classifierModel. Both call sites (xml_s1 and xml_s2) pass the same binding, and it is the function's 7th parameter — but the position is read out of the code rather than assumed, since argument order is exactly the kind of thing that shifts between builds.

The classifier request builder — the one function running both XML stages. Reassigning the parameter at the top covers every downstream use: the request body, the beta headers derived from it, and the telemetry that reports which model classified.

verify.describe: classifier model can be overridden by env
